title: Page seams 1: moves, overlay, hub whitelist, request lane, CSS links, tests dir
what:
FIRST, before editing: build master's perch with fake_eidolon and start it on 127.0.0.1:48103. Save a read_page baseline to scratch (not the repo) of:
- the left mesh tab
- the files tab (a tree listing, which calls tree?session=…)
- the inspector's loaded, diff, graph and run tabs
Then:
(1) Move LoadedTab to panes/loaded.js and DiffTab to panes/diff.js verbatim. Move Needs, Soon and Kv to core/bits.js. Import helpers from where they live, with no circular imports of app.js state; pass anything else in as props.
(2) GraphTab comes from graph/index.js and MeshTab from mesh/index.js. Both are stubs that render today's exact text.
(3) core/overlay.js: a signal of {component, props}, with a slot in Tiles next to Picker.
(4) core/api.js exports HUB_PATH, and hubCall uses it:
- regex ^(?:tree(?=[?])|(?:sessions|projects|dirs|models|trash|runs|mesh|meta|install|term|notes|mail)(?=/|[?]|$))
- any '..' segment is rejected
(5) core/lane.js: hubPoll(path, timeout) for every periodic GET.
- One request in flight across all polls; FIFO.
- A path already queued is coalesced (its callers share one answer), so a slow poll never piles up.
- hubGet/hubPost for user actions, terminal input and ask answers never enter the lane.
- core/hub.js's list and trash polls (hub.js:25-28) move onto it.
With 3 chat streams, the terminal stream and the lane, one of the browser's 6 connections per host stays free for typing and answers.
(6) index.html links graph/graph.css, mesh/mesh.css, terms/terms.css and notes/notes.css (empty files with one comment each).
(7) webui/term/tests/: a README and smoke.test.mjs, run with `node --test webui/term/tests/` (Windows node v26; pure modules only, no DOM).
Add README lines or files for core/, panes/, graph/, mesh/, terms/ and notes/.
tests:
smoke.test.mjs:
- HUB_PATH accepts tree?session=a&path=b, sessions/x/log, runs/x, mesh, meta/tools, install/keys, term/events, term/t3/input, notes/x/send and mail/abc/place.
- It rejects tree, treex, tree/x, ../x, termx, terminal and sessions/../x.
- It fails if the whitelist change is reverted.
lane.test.mjs:
- at most one request in flight across 5 pollers
- a queued duplicate path makes one fetch and both callers get its answer
- a hubPost issued while the lane is busy starts at once
- a failed poll frees the lane
live_check:
After S0P-b merges, run fake-perch.sh with PORT=48103 (the orchestrator, browser pane):
- read_page text of the six baseline views (files tab included) equals the saved baseline
- the sidebar list still refreshes
- the console is clean
risk: A moved component may close over app.js-local signals. Keep every move verbatim and pass the rest in as props. The lane changes the timing of the list poll, so check the 'hub unreachable' toast still fires on a dead perch.
